description: A resilient atomic image component that wraps native tags with consistent sizing, aspect-ratio control, fallback error state, and full WCAG 2.2 accessibility support.

properties.name: src
properties.description: The source URL of the image asset.

properties.name: alt
properties.description: Accessible text description. Omit or leave empty for decorative images.

properties.name: fit
properties.description: Controls containment, cropping, and aspect ratio preservation.

properties.name: customClass
properties.description: Custom CSS class to apply to the inner container.

events.name: imageLoad
events.description: Event emitted when the image loads successfully.

events.name: imageError
events.description: Event emitted when the image fails to load.
